records.family_name: Single-raised pot, early position vs BB

history.preflop: UTG opens 5bb, folds to BB, BB calls

villain.desc: Plays the equilibrium strategy. The 2200 anchor of the ladder.
villain.name: GTO

records.family_name: Single-raised pot, early position vs BB

history.preflop: UTG opens 5bb, folds to BB, BB calls

villain.desc:
Loose-passive calling station. Plays too many hands and calls a lot before the flop; after it he
folds a little less than most and checks hands he should bet. When he bets the river he usually
has it. The most common profitable opponent at $1/$2.
villain.name: Station
notes: hates folding a pair to a normal bet
checks his medium hands
bets smaller than he should with value
folds to bets a little less than most players
bets into the preflop raiser more than most (about 1 flop in 6)
does bluff the river sometimes: about 1 in 7 of his called river bets

records.family_name: Single-raised pot, early position vs BB

history.preflop: UTG opens 5bb, folds to BB, BB calls

villain.desc:
Tight and scared. Folds to pressure more than anyone, rarely bets when checked to, and his
river bets are almost never bluffs. Respect his aggression, attack his checks.
villain.name: Nit
notes: folds his weaker hands to pressure
checks his medium hands
folds to bets more than anyone: 7 flop bets in 10
rarely bets when checked to
almost never bluffs the river: about 1 in 20 called river bets

records.family_name: Single-raised pot, early position vs BB

history.preflop: UTG opens 5bb, folds to BB, BB calls

villain.desc:
Loose-aggressive to a fault. Bets and raises far too often, especially with air and draws,
and folds too little. Call him down lighter; let him bluff.
villain.name: Maniac
notes: bluffs big with nothing
folds to flop bets less than most players
bets into the preflop raiser more than anyone (more than 1 flop in 4)
bets most times he is checked to
a quarter of his called river bets are bluffs

records.family_name: Single-raised pot, early position vs BB

history.preflop: UTG opens 5bb, folds to BB, BB calls

villain.desc:
The recreational player who is there to gamble. Calls far too much, raises his draws, bets
into the raiser, and sizes his bets by hand strength (big = strong, small = not).
villain.name: Whale
notes: raises his draws
otherwise just calls
size tell: big bet = big hand
size tell: small bet = weak or drawing
calls flop and turn bets more than most players
bets into the preflop raiser often (about 1 flop in 5)
about 1 in 5 of his called river bets is a bluff
